task: Goose projection of native ggml_cuda_op_rope / ggml_cuda_op_rope_back (rope.cu) covering the Apex qwen35moe text RoPE path

sources.op_entry: ggml_cuda_op_rope(ctx, dst); srcs resolved from dst: src[0]=x, src[1]=pos (I32), src[2]=freq_factors (optional F32)

apex_path.layout: IMRoPE (mode 40): NeoX half pairs, theta position selected per pair from t/h/w/extra via sector%3 priority as native rope_multi
apex_path.priority: text IMRoPE path; NORMAL/NEOX/MROPE also implemented; nothing hardcoded in the kernel

op_params_int32.0: n_past (ignored by native kernels; policy ignores too)

recipes.name: ggml_cuda_op_rope_fused
recipes.reason: ROPE+VIEW+SET_ROWS fusion reads I64 row_indices; fg172r effect whitelist allows F32/F16/I32 loads only

recipes.name: ggml_cuda_op_rms_norm_mul_rope_fused
recipes.reason: RMS+MUL+ROPE one-block-per-row block-reduction kernel is outside the Apex text RoPE path and this module

packet_args.0: op id (0 forward, 1 backward; 2/3 rejected code 40, unknown rejected code 1)

plan.c_decl: struct fg172r_plan{uint64_t ptrs[5];uint64_t dims[4][4];uint64_t strides[4][4];uint64_t iv[32];float fv[8];};

host_ffi.fg172r_ti: (t,k,i)->i64; k: 0=src[j] handle (0 if absent), 1=data pointer, 2=type, 3=ne[i], 4=nb[i] bytes, 8=op_params int32[i], 9=ggml_nbytes checked span (must call)

device_effects.fg172r_f32_load/fg172r_f32_store: element-wise F32 at raw ptr + element index
device_effects.fg172r_f16_load/fg172r_f16_store: half<->f32 conversion at raw ptr + element index
device_effects.fg172r_lc/fg172r_psync: PDL grid primitives mirroring native ggml_cuda_pdl_lc/pdl_sync call sites (neox entry lc; neox+multi after offsets); safe as no-ops

device_entry.name: rope
device_entry.mapping: bi = blockDim.y*blockIdx.y + threadIdx.y, row_dst = blockDim.x*blockIdx.x + threadIdx.x
device_entry.launch: block(1,256,1), grid(nr, ceil(ne00/512), 1) with native CUDA_ROPE_BLOCK_SIZE=256; one thread owns one even pair i0=2*bi; no whole-tensor serial loop
device_entry.dummy_main: fn main(){rope(0,0,0);} retained for entry linkage; parent never executes it

dispatch: mirrors native if/else order: mode&2 -> NEOX half pairs; else mode&8 (mode!=24) -> MROPE/IMROPE half pairs with section theta; mode==24 VISION rejected upstream and returns untouched; else NORMAL adjacent pairs; backward only negates sin

policy_checks.rule: op in 0..3, ctx and node nonzero
src0 nb[0] equals element size (pairs must be element-adjacent)
native type combo: same type or F32->F16
x dims in range, whole-element strides, max row offset + ne0 within checked nbytes span
dst dims equal x dims (rope preserves shape)
n_offs>=0, even, n_offs+n_dims<=ne00 (rotated window inside row)
mrope/imrope requires one of sections[0..2]>0 (native assert)
VISION mode 24 unimplemented in this module

numeric_fidelity: theta_base = (float)pos[i2 + ne02*sec] * powf(theta_scale, (float)iw/2.0f): pair exponent uses float division exactly as native; freq_factors index iw/2 and ramp i0/2 use integer division as native
rotation stored as x0*cos_theta - x1*sin_theta then x0*sin_theta + x1*cos_theta in native order; no FMA rewriting introduced
rope_yarn mix theta_interp*(1-ramp_mix)+theta_extrap*ramp_mix and mscale*=1+0.1*logf(1/freq_scale) association preserved; sin negated only for backward
device offsets use i64 arithmetic; values identical to native 32-bit int math for every policy-valid input

corr_dims are computed host-side in f32; native computes the inner n_ctx_orig/(n_rot*2*M_PI) in double before narrowing to float, so the projection can deviate by <=1 ulp of the divisor; this only affects the ramp and only when ext_factor != 0; parent may pin fv4/fv5 to oracle values to isolate device math
device fmax/fmin are ternary comparisons matching ggml MAX/MIN macros; differs from fmaxf only on NaN, excluded by policy finiteness checks

tail (unrotated) passthrough copies columns i0,i0+1 from x to dst at the same in-row positions for every layout, matching both rope_norm and rope_neox/multi tail stores; inplace (x ptr == dst ptr) skips the tail as native
unimplemented: GGML_ROPE_TYPE_VISION (24) rope_vision kernel: vision-only layout (n_dims==ne00/2, whole-row pairs) is not part of the Apex text path; rejected with fail code 41
ROPE+VIEW+SET_ROWS fusion (ggml_cuda_op_rope_fused): requires I64 row_indices loads outside the fg172r whitelist; rejected code 40
ggml_cuda_op_rms_norm_mul_rope_fused: separate fused RMS+MUL+ROPE block-reduction kernel; rejected code 40
mode&1 n_past element skip: no native kernel support either; ignored exactly as native
no claim of full universal rope migration: only the four native public entries listed in recipes are covered, two of them explicitly rejected
